🐠 Our Story

Built on Freshness, Trust & Affordable Quality

Alayo Seafood Hubs was founded with one powerful mission: to make fresh, high-quality seafood accessible and affordable to every Nigerian household and food business.

Located at the heart of Anuoluwapo Seafood Market in Victoria Island, Lagos, we've grown to become the go-to destination for individuals, restaurants, caterers, and food businesses looking for the best seafood at the best prices.

From the waters to your table — every product you buy from us is handled with care, packed hygienically, and delivered or ready for pickup at peak freshness. We never compromise on quality.

🎯

Our Mission

To provide fresh, affordable seafood to every Nigerian — whether you're cooking for your family, running a restaurant, or catering a big event. Eat fresh, stay healthy.
